subject: Post-call: PeakTide trial — prompt & eval dataset collection plan
thread_text:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@peaktide.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: PeakTide trial — prompt & eval dataset collection plan

Hi Elena / Sam —

Thanks again for the call today — great discussion. Per our agreement, here’s a concise next-steps note to get your trial (POC) onto a concrete path. I’ve attached a short spec ('redwood_prompt_and_eval_spec_v1.pdf') that outlines formats and the minimal metadata we need. Summary below.

1) Goal / success criteria (mutually agreed)
- Retrieval + response generation use-case: reduce triage time for clinical intake emails by 60% and surface the correct disposition in top-1 result for clinician intent extraction >= 90% on P95.
- Latency target for interactive validation: P95 generation < 250ms (internal endpoint) with cost baseline to be discussed
- Hallucination threshold: < 2% on a manual sample review for clinically sensitive outputs

2) Eval dataset you will provide
- Prompt set: 2,000 anonymized clinical intake messages / user queries (CSV rows) + 200 labeled golden examples (intent + expected canonical response). Use the attached CSV template (PeakTide_prompt_sample.csv).
- Metadata we need: anonymized patient_id (hashed), timestamp, channel (email/portal), prior_intent (if available), redaction flag. See spec for exact columns.

3) Data delivery & security
- Delivery options: secure SFTP or shared Drive link to our intake folder (see link below). If you need a temporary S3 presigned upload, Sam — tell us and we’ll provision.
- Compliance: we will not store raw PHI; please follow the attached PT-POC-data-security-requirements.pdf for required redaction/hashing before transfer.

4) Redwood deliverables & timeline
- Week 1 (Aug 23–29): Ingest sample 200 prompts; run baseline eval and share an initial quality report.
- Week 2 (Aug 30–Sep 5): Full ingestion of 2k prompts, run candidate model runs, and deliver a draft success-metrics dashboard.
- Week 3 (Sep 6–Sep 12): Iteration on prompts/filters, handover of evaluation notebook and suggested rules for production.

5) Owners / points of contact
- PeakTide delivery: Elena Ruiz (primary), Sam Lee (engineering / S3 & redaction)
- Redwood: Mina Haddad (sales lead / program owner), Ben Carter (SE / evaluation owner), Marissa Cole (data ops & ingestion)

6) Action items for PeakTide (by Aug 25)
- Share 200-sample CSV (anonymized) for initial baseline
- Confirm preferred transfer method and any procurement contacts for the DPA

Elena — can you confirm the above and flag any missing objectives? Once we have the sample CSV and confirmation on transfer method, Ben and Marissa will schedule the ingestion window.

Best,
Mina
--
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@peaktide.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@peaktide.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: PeakTide trial — prompt & eval dataset collection plan

Thanks Mina — this looks good and aligned with what we discussed. A few clarifications and notes from our side: 

- We can provide the 200-sample anonymized CSV by EOD Aug 25. I’ll send it via the Drive link unless you prefer SFTP.
- For redaction: we’ll hash patient IDs and remove any free-text PHI per the PT-POC-data-security-requirements.pdf. Sam will coordinate the redaction scripts.
- Question on labeling: for the 200 golden examples, do you want multi-label intents or a single canonical intent per example? Our triage often has multi-intent messages.
- Procurement: I looped procurement@peaktide.com for the DPA; they asked for an estimated data retention window (how long will Redwood keep the sample?).

Attachments on our side we plan to include with the sample upload: PeakTide_prompt_sample.csv (first 200 rows), and a short readme called pt_sample_readme.md.

Thanks —
Elena

On Mon, Aug 23, 2027 at 10:04 AM Samuel Lee <sam.lee@peaktide.com> wrote:
> Quick note: we can do S3 presigned upload. If Redwood sends an upload URL, we’ll push the sample there and then follow with bulk upload for the 2k set.
> Sam

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@peaktide.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: PeakTide trial — prompt & eval dataset collection plan

Thanks — helpful notes. A few technical clarifications to make ingestion and evaluation smoother: 

- Preferred CSV format: UTF-8, comma separated. Column headers we expect: "prompt_id","anonymized_patient_hash","timestamp","channel","raw_text","label_intent_single","label_intent_multi" (pipe-delimited if multi),"redaction_flag". See the attached spec for exact column examples.
- Golden labels: we prefer a single-canonical-intent column for scoring (label_intent_single). For messages with true multi-intent, include the multi column too; our eval will map to primary intent for the top-1 metric and compute multi-label recall separately.
- Metadata: if you can include a speaker_role column (patient/clinic) that helps gating for our sampling.
- Retention: for this POC Redwood will retain the samples for the trial duration + 30 days post-trial for debugging (then we will delete unless you request otherwise). We can set a custom retention policy if PeakTide requires a shorter window — please indicate.

Next steps from Redwood engineering:
- I’ll provision an S3 presigned upload (if you confirm S3) and send the link to Sam via secure email by EOD today.
- After we ingest the 200-sample, we will run the baseline and share a short notebook and a CSV of failure cases for review.

If that all sounds good, Elena — we’re ready to receive the sample.

Cheers,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | (510) 555-0199

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@peaktide.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@peaktide.com, Sam Lee <sam.lee@peaktide.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: PeakTide trial — prompt & eval dataset collection plan

Ben / Mina — that works. We prefer the S3 presigned flow; Sam will accept the upload link and we’ll push the 200-sample today. Procurement notes: retention of trial data for 30 days post-trial is fine; I confirmed with procurement (procurement@peaktide.com). They requested that the presigned link be single-use and expire in 72 hours.

We’ll send the sample and readme in the next few hours. Thanks for the clear rubric — we’ll aim to populate label_intent_single where possible.

Best,
Elena

--
End of thread
